messages:
Maya: Quick design review — putting this here because I noticed a bunch of folks squinting at the compare table. The performance badge column is visually heavy and pushes the metrics off-screen on narrow viewports.
Sam: Yeah, felt that in the usability session. Row height + badge size = dense rows but noisy. We should try a compact badge (20px) and reduce vertical padding.
Jordan: Can we collapse less-important badges into a single overflow indicator (e.g., "+2") with a hover menu? Keeps scan path intact.
Lee: Accessibility nit: current badges are low contrast at small sizes. Need to ensure WCAG AA for foreground/background. Also badges must have aria-labels (e.g., "Latency p95: 120ms").
Priya: Copy suggestion: change badge text from "P95" to "Latency (p95)" — clearer for cross-functional folks who read quickly.
Maya: Version pinning UX — users told us they think a pinned version follows the filter context, but it actually persists across filters. That mismatch is causing confusion.
Sam: Maybe show a subtle global pinned banner in the table header when any version is pinned, and also keep a small pin indicator on the row. Makes persistence explicit.
Jordan: Mock idea: pin should be part of row quick-actions (three-dot menu) so it’s discoverable on hover, plus an inline pin icon when pinned.
Maya: Agree. Also we should prevent accidental unpins by making it a two-step action? Or a confirm toast with "Undo" would be enough.
Lee: Keyboard/Focus: tab order currently lands on the badge tooltip before row actions. Recommend linearizing: row selection -> primary metric -> actions -> badges. We should test with VoiceOver.
Priya: Microcopy: change tooltip title from "Performance" to "Performance metrics" and list metric name then value. e.g., "Latency (p95): 120ms". Clearer in screen reader output.
Sam: Quick perf/engineering ask — if we shrink badges we should keep the tappable area at least 32px for touch. CSS suggestion: keep visual 20px but padding for hit-target.
Jordan: UX tradeoff: compactness vs discoverability. For overflow badge use we could show top 2 badges + "+n". On click expand inline.
Maya: We ran a paper prototype with 6 participants — most preferred compact rows and overflow + small header banner for pinned version. I'll attach notes in the doc.
DesignBot: Reminder: add an a11y checklist card to the PR template: contrast, aria-labels, keyboard order, hit target sizes.
Lee: Also flag for QA: when switching filter groups, pinned-row highlight should persist. I found it disappearing in the current build.
Priya: Tiny copy nit for the compare toolbar — change "Pin version" CTA to "Pin model version" to reduce ambiguity.
Sam: +1 on wording. Also can we add a quick animation to show "pinning" state so users see that the global banner is tied to that action? Small fade + keyline.
Maya: Next steps: Sam to prototype compact badge styles + hit target, Jordan to mock overflow behavior, Lee to write a11y acceptance criteria, Priya to update copy strings, I'll consolidate and post a short usability follow-up.
Sam: I'll drop a lightweight CSS snippet in the thread later. :thumbsup:
Jordan: will share a Figma frame.
Lee: I'll run keyboard/VO checks once the mock is up.
Priya: Thanks team — will update i18n owners for copy changes.
Maya: Sweet, thanks.
